name: Northampton County, PA
findings: Northampton County has 1,002 nonprofit organizations. 474 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 395 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Northampton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Northampton County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few political organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 political organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through political groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 55 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
